title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #5

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which element do we breathe in? (1 mark)
   A. Jal
   B. Agni
   C. Vayu
   D. Prithvi

2. Which element is called Akash? (1 mark)
   A. Fire
   B. Water
   C. Earth
   D. Space

3. What does the Sanskrit word Panch mean in Panch Mahabhoot? (1 mark)
   A. Three
   B. Ten
   C. Seven
   D. Five

4. In which faith is the Rijubalika river important? (1 mark)
   A. Jainism
   B. Christianity
   C. Sikhism
   D. Islam

5. What was Guru Ram Das Ji's childhood name? (1 mark)
   A. Jetha
   B. Prahlad
   C. Siddhartha
   D. Ravi

6. What do the words nar and simha mean in Narsimha? (1 mark)
   A. King and queen
   B. Water and fire
   C. Sun and moon
   D. Man and lion

7. What does the story of the swan teach us? (1 mark)
   A. To be kind to animals and help the hurt
   B. To hunt for fun
   C. To ignore suffering
   D. To be proud

8. Which Enlightened Being is a Sikh Guru? (1 mark)
   A. Lord Buddha
   B. Sri Guru Ram Das Ji
   C. Narsimha
   D. Parshvanath

9. Match the being to the teaching. Which pair is correct? (1 mark)
   A. Buddha: Pride
   B. Narsimha: Greed
   C. Parshvanath: Ahimsa
   D. Guru Ram Das: Cruelty

10. A child promises to return a friend's book on time. Which scripture lesson is being followed? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping a promise, as in the Ramayan
   B. Sitting on heels
   C. Not stealing, as in Rijubalika
   D. Making a fast

11. What does the essence of a scripture mean? (1 mark)
   A. Its most important message
   B. Its length
   C. Its cover
   D. Its price

12. Whose hymns are also in Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji? (1 mark)
   A. Prahlad and Siddhartha
   B. Bhagat Kabir Ji and Bhagat Ravidas Ji
   C. Valmiki and Sigala
   D. Dasharatha and Ram

13. Which is a mistake about scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping it clean
   B. Making fun of another faith's holy book
   C. Listening carefully
   D. Reading with respect

14. Which pair is correct? (1 mark)
   A. Uttaradhyayan Sutra: Jainism
   B. Dhammapada: Sikhism
   C. Kalpasutra: Hinduism
   D. Ramayan: Buddhism

15. Which action follows the Jain teaching of gentleness? (1 mark)
   A. Not stepping on ants or hurting animals for fun
   B. Throwing stones
   C. Breaking eggs
   D. Chasing animals

16. Which of the Sigalovada teachings shows how to treat the people who help us at home or work? (1 mark)
   A. Respect and care for workers and helpers
   B. Shout at them
   C. Pay no attention
   D. Ignore them

17. How should we treat a scripture? (1 mark)
   A. With cleanliness and respect
   B. By writing on it
   C. By throwing it
   D. By sitting on it

18. What is darshan? (1 mark)
   A. Paying fees
   B. Running around
   C. Looking at the murti with respect
   D. Leaving early

19. What does the Gayatri Mantra compare wisdom to? (1 mark)
   A. A drum
   B. A river
   C. Light
   D. A mountain

20. What does the book stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Food
   B. Fire
   C. Rain
   D. Knowledge

21. How did the boy in the example story practise Asteya? (1 mark)
   A. He hid the purse
   B. He sold the purse
   C. He found the owner of the purse
   D. He kept the money

22. What should you do if you break something at school? (1 mark)
   A. Blame another child
   B. Run away
   C. Give it away
   D. Own up

23. What should Amina do about the extra money? (1 mark)
   A. Return the extra to the shopkeeper
   B. Spend it
   C. Keep it
   D. Give it away

24. Which two of the Buddha's five precepts appear in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Not to run and not to sing
   B. Not to sleep and not to eat
   C. Not to steal and not to lie
   D. Not to swim and not to sit

25. Which is a sign of integrity? (1 mark)
   A. Taking a friend's pen
   B. Keeping your promises
   C. Cheating in a test
   D. Telling lies

26. When should you practise yoga? (1 mark)
   A. While running
   B. When your stomach is not full
   C. While eating
   D. Right after a big meal

27. What should you wear for yoga? (1 mark)
   A. A raincoat
   B. Loose and comfortable clothes
   C. Heavy boots
   D. Tight clothes

28. Which is a common mistake? (1 mark)
   A. Praying
   B. Being honest
   C. Thinking Dharma is only for grown-ups
   D. Being kind to animals

29. What does Param mean in Paramatma? (1 mark)
   A. Highest
   B. Small
   C. New
   D. Quiet

30. Which is one of the four Purusharthas? (1 mark)
   A. Moksha
   B. Aarti
   C. Namaste
   D. Bhajan

31. What does Daya mean? (1 mark)
   A. Kindness or compassion
   B. Wealth
   C. Speed
   D. Anger

32. Maha Shivratri means what? (1 mark)
   A. The great night of Shiva
   B. The great day of the Sun
   C. The festival of lights
   D. The day of forgiveness

33. What does Madaraka Day teach? (1 mark)
   A. Greed
   B. Cruelty
   C. Patriotism and unity
   D. Pride

34. Maha Shivratri is a festival of which faith? (1 mark)
   A. Buddhism
   B. Sikhism
   C. Jainism
   D. Hinduism

35. Which practice is part of Paryushan? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating
   B. Fasting
   C. Hunting
   D. Shouting

36. In which month of the Indian traditional calendar is Maha Shivratri celebrated? (1 mark)
   A. Kartika
   B. Phalguna
   C. Chaitra
   D. Bhadrapada

37. What does the Moon do in modern science? (1 mark)
   A. It is a planet
   B. It goes around the Earth
   C. It goes around Mars
   D. It is a star

38. Which day is linked with Venus? (1 mark)
   A. Monday
   B. Friday
   C. Sunday
   D. Wednesday

39. Which planet is famous for its rings? (1 mark)
   A. Venus
   B. Mars
   C. Saturn
   D. Mercury

40. What is the Indian name for Friday? (1 mark)
   A. Shukravaar
   B. Somvaar
   C. Budhvaar
   D. Guruvaar

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Name two sacred rivers mentioned in the lesson. (2 marks)

42. Give three reasons why prayer is a principle of Dharma. (3 marks)

43. Explain the meaning of the word Paramatma. (2 marks)

44. Name two trees or plants that are sacred in different faiths. (2 marks)

45. Describe an experiment to show that plants need water. (4 marks)

46. Which festival in the lesson is a national holiday and why? (2 marks)

47. Suggest four activities for celebrating International Yoga Day in school. (4 marks)

48. Give the meaning of Maha Shivratri. (2 marks)

49. Why do the festival dates in this calendar change from year to year on our usual calendar? (2 marks)

50. Explain why a child should understand the meaning of a prayer. (4 marks)

51. Explain how children who find it hard to speak can join in prayers at assembly. (4 marks)

52. List three ideal practices of a passenger when boarding. (3 marks)

53. Explain the meaning of Ahimsa and give two ways to practise it. (3 marks)

54. Draw a timeline from January to December and mark Maha Shivratri, Madaraka Day and Paryushan. (4 marks)

55. Explain why yoga should be practised with an expert. (4 marks)

56. Explain why the River Rijubalika is important to Jains. (3 marks)

57. What do the words Param and atma mean? (2 marks)

58. A shopper gives you Ksh 500 and you buy items for Ksh 320. Work out the change and say what to do if you are given Ksh 200 by mistake. (4 marks)

59. What does the word Panch Mahabhoot mean? (2 marks)

60. Name the two Buddhist scriptures in this lesson. (2 marks)

61. Why should children do Bhastrika and Kapaal Bhaati gently? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Vayu
   Air is Vayu.

2. D — Space
   Akash is the open sky or space that holds everything.

3. D — Five
   Panch means five, and there are five great elements.

4. A — Jainism
   Jains believe Lord Mahavir became enlightened on its bank.

5. A — Jetha
   His childhood name was Jetha.

6. D — Man and lion
   Nar means man and simha means lion.

7. A — To be kind to animals and help the hurt
   Siddhartha showed kindness.

8. B — Sri Guru Ram Das Ji
   He was the fourth Guru of the Sikhs.

9. C — Parshvanath: Ahimsa
   Parshvanath is linked with non-violence.

10. A — Keeping a promise, as in the Ramayan
   Ram kept promises.

11. A — Its most important message
   The essence is the main lesson inside.

12. B — Bhagat Kabir Ji and Bhagat Ravidas Ji
   It includes holy men of other traditions.

13. B — Making fun of another faith's holy book
   We should respect all scriptures.

14. A — Uttaradhyayan Sutra: Jainism
   The Uttaradhyayan Sutra is a Jain scripture.

15. A — Not stepping on ants or hurting animals for fun
   Gentleness to living things is central.

16. A — Respect and care for workers and helpers
   Workers are one of the six directions.

17. A — With cleanliness and respect
   Scriptures are kept clean and high.

18. C — Looking at the murti with respect
   Darshan is a respectful sight of God.

19. C — Light
   Wisdom is like light that clears away darkness.

20. D — Knowledge
   The book stands for knowledge.

21. C — He found the owner of the purse
   He returned it.

22. D — Own up
   Owning up shows integrity.

23. A — Return the extra to the shopkeeper
   Integrity means giving it back.

24. C — Not to steal and not to lie
   Not stealing and not lying.

25. B — Keeping your promises
   Keeping promises shows honesty.

26. B — When your stomach is not full
   Do it with an empty stomach.

27. B — Loose and comfortable clothes
   Loose clothes help us move.

28. C — Thinking Dharma is only for grown-ups
   Children can practise Dharma too.

29. A — Highest
   Param means highest.

30. A — Moksha
   The four are Dharma, Artha, Kama and Moksha.

31. A — Kindness or compassion
   Daya is compassion.

32. A — The great night of Shiva
   Maha means great and ratri means night.

33. C — Patriotism and unity
   It teaches love for country.

34. D — Hinduism
   It is a Hindu festival.

35. B — Fasting
   Fasting, prayer and charity.

36. B — Phalguna
   Phalguna, in February or March.

37. B — It goes around the Earth
   The Moon is Earth's natural satellite.

38. B — Friday
   Shukravaar.

39. C — Saturn
   Saturn has bright rings.

40. A — Shukravaar
   Shukra is Venus.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: The Ganga and the Beas (or the Rijubalika).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct river.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: It makes us thankful, calm and humble, gives courage, and reminds us we are not alone (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: The Supreme Soul, or God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tulsi, Ber (Beri) tree, Bodhi tree, Sal tree (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct plant.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: Plant bean seeds in two tins of soil. Water one tin every day and give none to the other. Compare them after one and two weeks. The watered seeds sprout and grow but the dry seeds do not.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two tins, 1 mark for different watering, 1 mark for comparing over time, 1 mark for the result.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Madaraka Day, because it marks a step in Kenya's history and all Kenyans celebrate it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

47. (4 marks)
   Answer: Doing yoga together, taking photos or videos, making a chart of asanas, making a guidance video with an adult (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: The great night of Lord Shiva.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for great night and 1 mark for Shiva.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: The months follow the Moon, so the dates move.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

50. (4 marks)
   Answer: Understanding makes the prayer come from the heart, helps us remember it, and helps us live by its message. Rushing without meaning makes it only a habit.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point, up to 4.

51. (4 marks)
   Answer: They can hum, listen, join the actions or be helped by friends, so nobody is left out.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for four sensible points.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wait for the vehicle to stop, form a line and do not push, let children and elders go first, pay the fare honestly (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ahimsa is not harming any living being by thought, word or action. We practise it by not bullying and by caring for animals and plants.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for each example.

54. (4 marks)
   Answer: A line from January to December with Maha Shivratri in February or March, Madaraka Day on 1 June and Paryushan in August or September.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the line and months, 1 mark for each correct festival.

55. (4 marks)
   Answer: An expert shows the correct posture, corrects mistakes, prevents strain of the back or knees, and knows when to stop.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for four points.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jains believe Lord Mahavir became fully enlightened while sitting on its bank, so the river is honoured in Jainism.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the Jain link, 1 mark for Lord Mahavir, 1 mark for enlightenment.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: Param means highest and atma means soul.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

58. (4 marks)
   Answer: Change is 500 minus 320 = Ksh 180. If given Ksh 200, that is Ksh 20 too much, so return the Ksh 20 to the shopkeeper.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 500 minus 320, 1 mark for 180, 1 mark for the extra 20, 1 mark for returning it.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: Five great elements.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for five and 1 mark for great elements.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: The Dhammapada and the Sigalovada Sutta.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: They are active breathing exercises, so children need a teacher and must stop when tired.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.
